title: Invert Binary Tree
constraints: Tree is given as a level-order array; use -1 to represent null nodes
description:
Given the root of a binary tree (as a **level-order array**), invert the tree, and return the **level-order array** of the inverted tree.

Inverting a tree means swapping the left and right children of every node.

**Tree encoding:** Nodes are in level-order (BFS order). Use `-1` for missing nodes.

```text
Before inversion:        After inversion:

      4                        4
    /   \                    /   \
   2     7        →         7     2
  / \   / \               / \   / \
 1   3 6   9             9   6 3   1

Input:  [4, 2, 7, 1, 3, 6, 9]
Output: [4, 7, 2, 9, 6, 3, 1]
```

tests.explanation: Left and right subtrees are swapped at every level.
